entities.summary: National Assembly, a political institution in Ecuador during The Correa Era and Contemporary Ecuador (2017–2026). Grew from 2008 Constitution — first to recognize rights of nature (Pachamama) and Correa and the Citizens' Revolution. Led to the emergence of October 2019 indigenous-led protests paralyze Ecuador and Daniel Noboa elected youngest president — 2023; declares internal armed conflict.
